name: Device Calendar
description: Enables AI and users to create, schedule, and view native device calendar events and meetings seamlessly through conversational requests (e.g. 'créame una reunión') and slash commands.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.1.0: Full AI conversational support ('créame una reunión'), robust date and title extraction, direct JSON payload routing, minimalist black-and-white icon, and standardized ToolResult responses without canned static messages.

tools.description: Creates or schedules a meeting or event in the device calendar. Use whenever the user asks to schedule, book, or create an appointment or meeting (e.g. 'créame una reunión', 'agenda una cita', 'crear evento'). Syntax: /calendar <title> [| <startDate>] [| <endDate>] [| <description>]
Comando directo para agendar una reunión en el calendario. Sintaxis: /reunion <título> [| <fecha_inicio>]
List events in the device calendar for a date range: /calendar-list <startDate> <endDate>

settings.label: Default Calendar Identifier
settings.description: Target calendar ID for scheduled events ('primary' uses the system default).

settings.label: Default Duration (Minutes)
settings.description: Default event duration in minutes if no end time is specified.
